design.purpose: A sturdy open storage basket for yarn, toys or bathroom items, for one maker; green base and lower wall, blue upper wall.

steps.c: Make a magic ring with green yarn
Rnd 1: 6 sc in ring, pull tight
Rnd 2: inc in each stitch, 12 sc
Rnd 6: sc in back loop only, 30 sc
Rnd 7: sc in each stitch, 30 sc
Rnd 8: sc in each stitch, 30 sc
Complete last stitch with blue yarn
Rnd 9: sc in each stitch, 30 sc
Rnd 10: sc in each stitch, 30 sc
Rnd 11: sc each stitch, sl st to join
Snip blue yarn, leave a 15 cm tail
Pull tail through last loop and tighten
Weave both tails through nearby stitches
Snip green tail close to work
Snip blue tail close to work
Push base flat and shape wall upright
